name: Castelforte (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castelforte (a comet on blue) within branches, with the motto FORTIS IN SUBLIMI on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Castelforte, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castelforte arms — comet on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto FORTIS IN SUBLIMI
